title: A LISTENER HEARS PLAYER 2 RUN
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A Listener that is hunting you keeps tracking you while you move, and it hears a sprinting player from further off than a walking one. In co-op, when it was hunting player 2, it judged that by whether the host was sprinting. So player 2 could sprint away and slip it at a range where the host never could, and player 2 walking quietly was still tracked from the sprinting distance whenever the host happened to run. It now listens to the sprint of the player it is hunting. Solo is unchanged.
now: In co-op, a hunting Listener now hears player 2 by his own sprint, not the sprint of the host.
